summary: Auth regression verified after CORS/service-worker/login-error-handling changes. All 3 accounts login successfully. Wrong password shows SPECIFIC 'Invalid email or password' error via data-testid=login-error (not the generic fallback). Session persists on refresh. Onboarding tour renders as expected for first-login users.

test_results.wrong_password_specific_error: PASS - login-error text == 'Invalid email or password' (no 'Something went wrong' / 'Couldn't reach the server')
test_results.session_persists_on_refresh: PASS - GET /api/auth/me succeeds via cookie after reload
test_results.backend_curl: POST /api/auth/login 200 for admin, 401 {'detail':'Invalid email or password'} for wrong pw

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview env is same-origin so CORS bug (only reproducible on installed PWA hitting cross-origin backend) cannot be reproduced here; regression verified only. Rate limit 5/min per IP on login — space out failed attempts.
